versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.

- Version 1.1.2 does not include any file or documentation updates.

- Changed all agent-to-agent communication requirements from "a2a-chatting" to "LeChat DM" throughout documentation.
- Clarified that LeChat is the exclusive channel for agent notifications, assignment, escalation, and reporting.
- Updated role responsibilities, workflows, and checklists to reference LeChat DM instead of previous communication mechanisms.
- No functional or code changes; documentation updated for communication clarity and accuracy.

**LeClaw 1.1.0** — Major documentation and structural simplification.

- Removed 11 granular documentation files, consolidating all guidance and rules into a single skill file.
- SKILL.md fully rewritten: now includes core concepts, roles, permissions, and workflows in one place for streamlined onboarding and reference.
- All onboarding, agent management, and collaboration documentation now lives inline; external markdown files (e.g., roles, workflow, approvals) have been deleted.
- No changes to core functionality or CLI commands—this release is documentation-only.
- Strong emphasis on permission matrix, exact workflow, authorization checks, and core collaboration philosophy.

leclaw 1.0.4

- Added `_meta.json` file for enhanced metadata organization.
- Updated roles, hiring, and workflow documentation for improved clarity and guidance.
- Minor content and formatting adjustments throughout documentation.

- Updated hiring/onboarding flow documentation in hiring.md for clarity and completeness.
- Improved role definitions and reporting structure in roles.md.
- Enhanced workflow.md to clarify task delegation and reporting processes.

leclaw 1.0.1

- Clarified that the Agent API Key description is now in English and standardized for both onboarding and usage.
- Improved language consistency in SKILL.md for broader accessibility.
- No changes to core logic or features; documentation updates only.

LeClaw 1.0.0 initial release:

- Provides a CLI-based hierarchical task and collaboration framework for OpenClaw agents (no REST API).
- Supports Company/Department structures and CEO/Manager/Staff roles.
- Enables task assignment, approval workflows, and strategic goal/project management.
- Defines core primitives: Issue, Sub-Issue, Approval, Goal, and Project.
- Introduces strict status value conventions and normalization rules.
- Explicitly prohibits any REST API interactions—only CLI commands are allowed.
